id: title:VojtechBartos:allow in the slack dev app project allowlist

review.posthog_relevance: Clarifies Slack dev app OAuth credential and team ID allowlist behavior, distinguishing between allowing all projects and allowing specific ones.
review.reason: Adds documentation warning against using wildcard (*) for all projects while simultaneously implementing support for the wildcard in the team ID allowlist. This represents a configuration and access control change rather than a broad systemic improvement. The implementation broadens access for Slack dev apps by allowing a wildcard team ID, while documentation explicitly warns this.
review.uncertainty: The actual production impact and whether this configuration change is widely adopted or causes unintended access cannot be verified from the code alone; the warning and implementation suggest a deliberate, bounded change rather than a systemic capability improvement.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains documentation and implementation changes. The documentation explicitly warns against using a wildcard (*) in production, while the implementation adds support for the wildcard. This suggests a configuration change rather than a broad systemic improvement. No tier assignment is made.
